description: read-only: one code-exploration sub-agent dispatch on the plugin repo; the plugin's model-tiering module picks the sub-agent model (#70 DoD; compare with subagent-exploration)
prompt: Read {{PLUGIN_ROOT}}/shared/sub-agents/code-exploration.md and {{PLUGIN_ROOT}}/shared/model-tiering.md. Dispatch exactly one sub-agent with the Agent tool using the Prompt Template, with {purpose} = "issue-context", passing `model` as model-tiering.md resolves it for key `code-exploration` (omit it when that resolves to `inherit`). Substitute: task = "Explore the codebase to gather technical context for an issue"; issue type = improvement; issue description = "Change shared/api-dispatch.md so coordinators read only the host-API sections they need (Authentication, the operation's section, Pagination when paginating, Field Reference when cited) by file path, instead of loading the whole gitlab-api/github-api/gitea-api SKILL.md through the Skill tool. Extend .ci/smoke-test.sh to validate the new pointer form."; repo = project-workflow-claude-plugin; local path = {{PLUGIN_ROOT}}; project context = "Claude Code plugin: Markdown skills under skills/, shared modules under shared/, CI under .ci/.". Do not explore the code yourself. When the sub-agent returns, reply with only its JSON.
